## The problem

<!-- What does a local model get wrong today, or what can the kit not yet do? A feature that maps to a real
     failure mode is far more likely to land than a general "wouldn't it be nice". -->

## Proposed behavior

<!-- What should happen instead. If it is a new gate: what would it COMPUTE, and from what? The kit's rule
     is that a check a script can settle should be a script, not a prompt - keep that in mind. -->

## How it would be verified

<!-- Every change here ships with a test. Sketch the Test-Case: what input should the gate pass, and what
     input must it fail? A feature whose success cannot be checked deterministically is a hard sell. -->

## Scope / stack

<!-- Which command/agent/profile does this touch? Is it general, or specific to one stack (dotnet, python,
     web, ...)? -->
